name: C062 Linh Mục Mù (Trượng Chuông Bạc Thanh Tẩy)
prompt_ref:
Create a single-cell 1x1 reference sheet of a dark-fantasy Blind Priest's silver bell purification staff (Trượng Chuông Bạc Thanh Tẩy - C062 Linh Mục Mù) following the exact square cell of the attached reference layout_guide_1x1.png.

COMPOSITION & ORIENTATION (100% MANDATORY):
- Draw ONE complete purification staff oriented DIAGONALLY from bottom-left (silver-shod ashwood shaft) to top-right (ornate circular silver halo ring housing three sacred engraved silver chimes and pale cyan-white cleansing runes).
- Must show 100% of the entire staff from bottom tip to top silver bell halo with generous padding inside the frame (occupying 65%-75% of the canvas).
- Zero clipping at canvas edges.

COLOR & BACKGROUND (100% MANDATORY):
- Background MUST be flat solid pure magenta (#FF00FF) edge-to-edge.
- DO NOT use any magenta/pink tones on the staff itself (use tarnished antique silver, pale ashwood, white silk cloth wraps, and soft cyan-white runic glow).
- No character hands, no text, no borders.
prompt_card:
Create a wide horizontal 16:11 dark-fantasy card illustration featuring the exact same Silver Bell Purification Staff (Trượng Chuông Bạc Thanh Tẩy - C062 Linh Mục Mù) from the attached reference image.

COMPOSITION & BACKGROUND (100% MANDATORY):
- Place the silver bell halo staff diagonally across the center of the horizontal frame.
- Full atmospheric dark-fantasy background (100% opaque RGB illustration, NO magenta, NO transparency): an ancient stone shrine where ripples of silver-cyan soundwaves and cleansing runes radiate from the sacred chimes, dissolving dark curse smoke.
- Do NOT draw any card frame, borders, or text.
